description: FirePulse AI is a NASA satellite-based wildfire monitoring platform. It aims to harmonize MODIS and VIIRS active fire hotspot data and visualize historical fire activity through an interactive dashboard. Key features include hotspot mapping, burning activity calendars, historical trend analysis, anomaly detection, and CSV data exports. Built using Python, Pandas, Flask, Plotly, and Machine Learning.
summary: PyroNexa is a satellite fire intelligence platform designed to explore and analyze wildfire hotspots by harmonizing MODIS and VIIRS satellite observations. It provides an interactive fire map, monthly and yearly fire patterns, historical trend analysis, sensor comparison, and anomaly detection using Z-score and Median Absolute Deviation (MAD). Users can explore hotspot records and identify unusual fire activity through an integrated dashboard. PyroNexa aims to make satellite fire data easier to understand and support more informed wildfire monitoring and analysis.
details:
PyroNexa is a satellite fire intelligence platform developed for the challenge “Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots.”

The platform provides an interactive dashboard to explore satellite-based fire hotspot observations and understand patterns in fire activity.

Key features include:

  1. Overview Dashboard – Displays key fire activity indicators.
  2. Live Fire Map – Provides an interactive geographical view of fire hotspots.
  3. Burning Calendar – Helps explore monthly and yearly fire patterns.
  4. Historical Analysis – Supports historical fire trend exploration.
  5. Sensor Comparison – Helps compare MODIS and VIIRS hotspot observations.
  6. Anomaly Detection – Uses Z-score and Median Absolute Deviation (MAD) techniques to identify unusual activity.
  7. Data Explorer – Allows users to explore hotspot records.
  8. About & Science – Provides information about the project and its scientific context.

TECHNOLOGIES USED:
Python, Flask, Pandas, NumPy, Plotly, Leaflet, HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

AI ASSISTANCE DISCLOSURE:
AI-assisted tools, including ChatGPT and Google Antigravity, were used during parts of the development process for coding assistance, debugging, and content preparation. An AI-generated voice-over was used in the demonstration video. The team reviewed and integrated the project components.

PyroNexa aims to make satellite fire observations easier to explore, compare and understand through interactive visualization and data analysis. It is an exploratory monitoring platform and is not intended to replace official fire alerts or emergency-response systems.
